Get Started

A publisher for developers who think big.

Infinite Quantum (IQ) is a gaming and interactive entertainment brand. The infinity symbol in our logo stands for the word Infinite: games with no ceiling and communities that keep growing.

Publish

Launch planning, release support and distribution for games ready to reach players.

Partner

Working relationships with independent developers and studios, built on clear terms.

Grow

Marketing and player communities that keep a game alive after launch day.

Game Publishing

From the first build to a live community, we cover the work around the game so developers can focus on making it.

Game launches

Release planning, store presence and launch-day coordination.

Game marketing

Trailers, creatives and campaigns that show a game to the right players.

Player communities

Spaces where players give feedback, share clips and stay connected.

Developer Network

We are building a network of developers and studios who want a publishing partner. Join early and help shape how it works.

  • Mobile and PC games, original projects welcome
  • Solo developers, small teams and established studios
  • Straightforward partnership conversations before anything is signed
Join the network

What we look for

A playable build or a clear prototype, a developer who ships, and a game with something distinct to offer players.

Falkron Studio

The game development side of our ecosystem: game design, 3D development, and mobile and PC games, including original projects.

Falkron Studio Production handles creative production: promotional content, video and visual content, and marketing creatives.

Make and publish under one roof.

Falkron Studio builds games. Infinite Quantum publishes them. Developers outside the studio are equally welcome to partner with IQ.
